title: Episode script
description: One episode, split into scenes. Quotations are referenced by source id only.

format.description: The episode's format, from the closed catalog docs/formats.md (chosen with the skill choose-format, decided by the owner). scripts/validate.py checks its structure in the reels not validated yet

style.description: The episode's visual style, from the closed catalog docs/styles.md; it follows the format (paper for stories, chalk for misconceptions, illumination for collections and explained texts, flat for practical and two paths), decided by the owner on 2026-11-09

validated_by.description: Owner who validated the reel's script and translation; removed whenever one of its lines changes

whole.description: Order of the whole-episode videos (16:9 and 9:16) when it is not the reels one after another: a story told with suspense, its three events, then what they meant (khidr, owner's choice, 2026-11-08). Each part is a YouTube chapter. A scene without `reel` is said only here; a scene of a reel left out of the parts is said only in its reel. Without `whole`, the whole episode plays every scene in file order, one chapter per reel

validated_by.description: Owner who validated this order and the lines said only in the whole episode (scenes without reel); removed whenever one of them changes

publish.description: Publication texts pasted with the video by the owner (video/scripts/publish.ts adds the sources, credits, chapters and the other hashtags). On the episode: the whole episode's title and description, and the theme hashtags of all its videos; on a reel: its title and description (and hashtags of its own)

validated_by.description: Owner who validated these texts (on the episode: with its hashtags); removed whenever one of them changes

thumbnail.description: YouTube thumbnail of the whole 16:9 episode (1280x720, Thumbnail169 still), short texts taken from the validated title. The owner validates the rendered image (validated_by), removed whenever one of these fields changes

layout.description: Closed catalog of layouts (video/src/Thumbnail.tsx): poster = the subject biggest on the theme's colour, the other line small in a tag, a face beside them (2026-11-10: eight of nine thumbnails looked the same and their subject was unreadable at 170 px); close-up = a big face next to the text; scene = the character in its background, text on a band; title = the text alone on the cards' dark blue

big.description: Which line says the subject and is drawn biggest (poster layout, and the thumbnails of the chalk and illumination styles): headline by default; kicker when the headline is the formula (« ٣ أفكار غلط ») and the kicker the theme (« عن الدعاء »)

color.description: The theme's colour in the poster layout, from the closed palette of video/src/Thumbnail.tsx: two episodes side by side on the channel page are told apart before a word is read; not the colour of the last two thumbnails

validated_by.description: Owner who validated the rendered image

role.description: What the scene does in its format (docs/formats.md): event = what happened in a story, told in Egyptian close to the text's words, then proven by its verse or hadith; lesson = the lesson drawn from it (our own line, checked by the owner first), followed by an example; example = a typical scene of today's life (« Like when… »), never a true story

reel.description: The reel the scene belongs to. Without it, the scene is said only in the whole episode, and must be in `whole`

mentions.description: Real people named in the scene (prophets, Companions, known people). Forbids characters.

say_ar.description: What the voice reads when the pronunciation must differ from the text shown: the same words, a silent ta marbuta written ha (« عادة » read « عاده »). The screen shows narration.ar.

reel_only_end.description: End of the narration said only in the reel on its own (the open loop to the next reel, « ده اللي جاي »): the whole-episode videos stop the line just before it. Whole phrases at the end of narration.ar, and the matching end of narration.en.

caption.description: A drawn scene that also writes its narration line (narration.ar) in large letters over the picture, phrase by phrase as the voice says it, the first phrase from the first frame: for the opening line of a reel (what a viewer reads in the first second, sound on or off) and for the sentence to keep. Only on a scene without characters (the text takes the top of the picture)
